==About==

Crafting a {{i|Tenderboiled Terrine}} will make an {{i|Unboiled Tenderboiled Terrine}} which can then be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}} or {{i|Copper Pot}} for 6 hours to produce a Tenderboiled Terrine.
